job.job_description:
Role & Responsibilities -

Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications using Python, Azure OpenAI, and relevant AI frameworks.
Build sophisticated Agentic AI workflows and multi-agent architectures involving supervisor agents, planner agents, utility agents, and specialized task-execution agents.
Develop agent orchestration workflows for autonomous decision-making, task planning, tool selection, API execution, validation, and multi-step problem-solving.
Implement tool calling, function calling, and REST API integrations to connect AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, and business systems.
Build and optimize LLM-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge sources to provide contextually relevant and grounded responses.
Implement agent state management, workflow routing, error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls for reliable AI execution.
Integrate Azure OpenAI and Azure AI services into scalable enterprise AI solutions.
Develop backend services and AI APIs using Python, FastAPI, and REST APIs.
Implement LLM evaluation, response validation, hallucination mitigation, and performance optimization to improve the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Monitor and optimize AI application performance, latency, token consumption, retrieval quality, and execution accuracy.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable Agentic AI solutions.
Follow engineering best practices for security, access control, testing, deployment, maintainability, and production readiness.





Preferred Candidate Profile

Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI application development, with demonstrable experience building agentic workflows in real-world projects.
Strong Python programming and backend development experience.
Proven experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems and agent orchestration workflows. Candidates with only basic chatbot or standalone RAG experience will not be sufficient.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong understanding of agent planning, routing, tool selection, function calling, API execution, workflow state management, and agent collaboration.
Experience integrating LLMs with enterprise APIs, databases, and external tools.
Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and preferably Azure AI services.
Good understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and prompt engineering.
Experience handling agent failures, retries, validation, guardrails, and human approval workflows.
Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination reduction, tracing, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Experience developing production-ready AI applications using FastAPI, REST APIs, and scalable backend architectures.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
Ability to explain the architecture, workflow design, tools, integrations, and code personally implemented in previous Agentic AI projects.

Key Must-Haves: Agentic AI, multi-agent workflow implementation, Python, LLM/GenAI, agent orchestration, tool/function calling, and hands-on experience with LangGraph or an equivalent framework.

Good to Have: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, MCP (Model Context Protocol), advanced RAG, LLM observability, evaluation frameworks, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
